name: Shah Ismail Dehlawi
role: Reformist scholar of tawhid and religious purification
contribution: His reformist writings emphasized tawhid and criticized practices he saw as religious deviation, shaping revivalist debates across India.
context: Linked to the Waliullahi and Tariqah-i-Muhammadiya milieu, he became influential in nineteenth-century reformist arguments.
impact: He helps explain the wider religious-purification debates that reached Bengal-linked reform networks.
highlight: A major voice in South Asian debates over tawhid and religious reform.
seoTitle: Shah Ismail Dehlawi: Tawhid and Religious Reform in South Asia
seoDescription: Learn about Shah Ismail Dehlawi’s reformist writings, emphasis on tawhid, and influence on nineteenth-century religious debates linked to Bengal.
shortAnswer: Shah Ismail Dehlawi was a reformist scholar whose writings on tawhid shaped religious-purification debates across nineteenth-century South Asia.
